question: Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the letter-cluster that is different.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/343ce7cc46fb55bf788f900ae54002f3c875f860efc2a7c5ef81fd8873884d86.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94da4f5a371fbd128ea52749383d54a11d9278b8575c60f1c79230cd1ec6cda6.png] 

1) AEU → Here A, E, U alphabets are vowels.

2) AEI → Here A, E, I alphabets are vowels.

3) IOU → Here I, O, U alphabets are vowels.

4) ZDK → Here Z, D, K alphabets are consonants.

Hence, the correct answer is **"ZDK".**
